title: Kevin Knuth Ph.D. "The Scientific Study of Unidentified Aerospace-Undersea Phenomena (UAP)"
description:
Dr. Knuth is a Professor of Physics at the University at Albany (SUNY) and the Editor-in-Chief of the journal Entropy (MDPI). He is a former NASA research scientist having worked at NASA Ames Research Center in the Intelligent Systems Division designing artificial intelligence algorithms for astrophysical data analysis. His current research interests include the foundations of physics, quantum information, autonomous robotics, the search for and characterization of extrasolar planets, and unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP). He has published over 100 peer-reviewed scientific publications and has been invited to give over 100 presentations in 18 countries.

After decades of dismissal and secrecy, it has become clear that a significant number of the world's governments take Unidentified Aerospace-Undersea Phenomena (UAP), formerly known as Unidentified Flying Objects (UFOs), seriously -- yet still seem to know little about them. As a result, these phenomena are increasingly attracting the attention of scientists around the world, some of whom have recently formed research efforts to monitor and scientifically study UAP.  In this talk I will review some of the major scientific efforts to study UAP, while dispelling many of the popular misconceptions about UAP/UFOs, such as the ideas that: 1) UFOs are an American phenomenon, which started in 1947, 2) they are all thought to be alien spacecraft,  3) there is never any physical evidence, 4) astronomers and scientists never see them, 5) they have never been seriously studied.  Instead, we will see that UAP/UFOs are a class of phenomena, which have been observed and documented for hundreds, even thousands, of years.  Not only have they been observed by scientists and astronomers, but they have been studied by them as serious concerning phenomena.  Moreover, in addition to sightings, imagery, electromagnetic, radar and sonar measurements, as well as UAP behaviour studies, there exists physical evidence from landings.  Together, all of this evidence makes it clear that many UAP are physical objects, which are demonstrably and quantitatively anomalous.
